Provides a resource to create a IGTM address pool

> **NOTE:** Resource `tencentcloud.Igtm.Instance` needs to be created before using this resource.

import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

    addressSets: [
        {

            isEnable: "ENABLED",
            weight: 90,
        },
        {

            isEnable: "DISABLED",
            weight: 50,
        },
    ],
});

package main

			PoolName:        pulumi.String("tf-example"),
			TrafficStrategy: pulumi.String("WEIGHT"),
			AddressSets: igtm.AddressPoolAddressSetArray{
				&igtm.AddressPoolAddressSetArgs{
					Addr:     pulumi.String("1.1.1.1"),
					IsEnable: pulumi.String("ENABLED"),
					Weight:   pulumi.Int(90),
				},
				&igtm.AddressPoolAddressSetArgs{
					Addr:     pulumi.String("2.2.2.2"),
					IsEnable: pulumi.String("DISABLED"),
					Weight:   pulumi.Int(50),
				},
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}

## Import



IGTM address pool can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Igtm/addressPool:AddressPool example 1012132
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
